# wgcf generated OpenAPI client

This directory contains the generated OpenAPI client from
[`github.com/ViRb3/wgcf/v2` v2.2.32](https://github.com/ViRb3/wgcf/tree/v2.2.32/openapi).
It is included because its upstream `go.mod` has a placeholder module path,
which prevents downstream consumers from inheriting wgcf's local replacement.
Apart from correcting that module path, the Go source is unmodified.
